# archestra_project_file (Resource)

Project-owned file bytes with scoped import and deletion. UTF-8 Markdown/text content up to 1,000,000 bytes updates in place; other content changes replace the file. Initial uploads require at least one byte. Filename collisions fail without overwriting the existing file; project instructions use the project's instructions attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_project" "example" {
  name = "Managed project"
}

# The initial upload must contain at least one byte. Later .md/.txt UTF-8
# content edits up to 1,000,000 bytes update in place, including clearing.
# Binary content, filename, MIME hint and project changes replace the file.
# Keep instructions.md in archestra_project.instructions instead.
resource "archestra_project_file" "example" {
  project_id     = archestra_project.example.id
  filename       = "notes.txt"
  content_base64 = base64encode("Synthetic project notes.\n")
}

# content_base64 is sensitive and is stored in Terraform state.
# Use filebase64("./asset.bin") for binary uploads up to 25 MiB.
# An existing filename causes an error; import its scoped identity to adopt it.
# When importing, omit upload_mime_type because that creation hint is not retained.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive) Canonical base64 bytes; use filebase64 or base64encode in configuration.
- `filename` (String) Exact safe basename, excluding the reserved instructions.md file.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project UUID.

### Optional

- `upload_mime_type` (String) Creation-only MIME hint; omission uses the API default.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) File creation timestamp.
- `download_ref` (String) Stable artifact download handle.
- `downloadable` (Boolean) Whether the backing file is available for download.
- `file_id` (String) Observed file-row UUID.
- `id` (String) Composite identity project_uuid:file_uuid.
- `mime_type` (String) Actual stored MIME type, independent of the download response's safe Content-Type.
- `project_name` (String) Observed project name.
- `sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the observed bytes.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Observed byte length.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Project UUID and file UUID are both required to verify ownership.
terraform import archestra_project_file.example "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001:00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"
```
